name: KPIten - KPI reporting dashboard
short_desc: A KPI reporting dashboard built during my internship, pulling data from two Odoo instances.
long_desc: An internal tool that reports on manufacturing and analytic KPIs sourced from two Odoo instances (v16 and v18). Data is fetched via odoorpc, reshaped with Polars pivot/union pipelines, and rendered as styled tables and charts. The project also involved integrating the tool into the company's Docker/Traefik setup and building a token-based authentication flow so the dashboard can be opened directly from Odoo.

name: Home server
short_desc: Turning a spare laptop into a self-hosted home server, without router access.
long_desc: Repurposing a spare laptop as a small self-hosted server for personal projects. Covers OS choice (a minimal, security-conscious Linux distribution), a Dockerised setup for the running services, and using Cloudflare Tunnel to expose services publicly without access to the home router for port forwarding.

name: Breakcore production
short_desc: Exploring breakcore music production, from drum break chopping to synthesis basics.
long_desc: A personal music production project exploring breakcore: chopping and sequencing drum breaks as one-shot samples, and learning synthesis fundamentals (oscillators, filters, ADSR). Currently on standby while sourcing more source material and samples to work with.

name: Nexus Portal Companies - Backend
short_desc: Recreating part the part of my IUT's ERP that handles the relations between itself and companies through internships and work-studies.
long_desc: A full-stack dockerized Node website that features a REST API that allows users to manage internships and work-studies, defenses and teachers bound to them, student's work related documents.

name: Vega-py
short_desc: A CLI-first tool to manage front and themes under Arch Linux
long_desc: Making a tool that allows an Arch-based distro user to manage their UI tools' appearance in an easier way. This includes Waybar, WOFI, SwayNC and Sway / Scroll itself. Also allows installing and setting up DEs with one command.
